worlds.title: Gas Processing Station
worlds.description: Filter-separators, scrubbers and big yellow pipe loops, matched to a reference photo.

worlds.title: Golden Harbor
worlds.description: Low sun over a rolling sea: sailboats and buoys ride the swell past a lighthouse islet.

worlds.title: Low-Poly Island
worlds.description: A faceted island with pine forests, boulders and a lighthouse on the point.

worlds.title: Neon City
worlds.description: A night-time grid of towers with glowing window bands and lit streets.

worlds.title: Coastal Oil Refinery
worlds.description: A kilometer of process units, pipe racks, tank farm and a burning flare, with a tanker riding the swell at the marine jetty.

worlds.title: Refinery at Dusk
worlds.description: A coastal refinery at blue hour from a drone: thousands of lights, steam plumes lit from below, tanks, stacks and the bay beyond.
